quote: We evaluate performance on task 1 by computing the Precision, Recall, and Macro F1-score of the predicted labels against the annotated gold labels (Entailment/Contradiction).

For quality assurance, 3 volunteers re-classified 100 randomly sampled test instances, recording an average accuracy of 85% with respect to our gold labels and a Cohen's kappa of 0.83, indicating substantial inter-annotator agreement.
guideline: Annotators were provided with an annotation guide, displayed in the appendix, which was refined following the annotation of 100 pilot examples by the principal expert annotator to optimize the overall annotation process.
